magnon.D_method: omega/q^2 extrapolated to q^2 -> 0 over the three smallest commensurate points; the naive omega-vs-q^2 slope is D_naive_slope_meV_A2

curie.protocol: 1.0 ps per T, L=6 (432 atoms), dt=0.05 fs, alpha=0.3

coupling.note: C = [E(+du,+eps) - E(+du,-eps) - E(-du,+eps) + E(-du,-eps)]/(4 du eps) at 54 atoms, du = 0.02 A; transverse = tilt off the collinear axis (magnon channel, must vanish for a spin-rotational invariant potential); longitudinal = change of |S| (exchange-striction channel)

FM.note: acoustic slope over the first 5 finite-q points of Gamma-H ([001]) and Gamma-P ([111]); only branches with omega(Gamma) < 0.05 THz are used, otherwise the flat optical branches win the sort. v in m/s, C = rho v^2 in GPa, rho = 2 m_Fe / a^3. These are finite-q slopes of the finite-displacement dispersion; the r18 model gave 8.26 km/s for v_L[001] with a different supercell and symmetrisation, so treat 7-8 km/s as the family value and not as a precision elastic constant

a0_vs_moment.note: 54-atom EOS cell (3x3x3 conventional cubes), spin-polarised energy scan with m fixed; beta = dln a0/dln m is the volume magnetostriction coefficient of the model. Absolute a0 here is the same 54-atom construction as model_series.eos, which is 0.003-0.01 A below the 343-atom relaxation of the same state -- compare like with like

exchange.convention: H = -1/2 sum_ij J_ij e_i.e_j; J_n are the Fourier components of the model's angular energy functional within the 6.0 A cutoff
exchange.note: J in meV for the model's own |S| = 2.4546 muB; J_per_m2 is the same number divided by m^2, for comparison with literature Heisenberg parameters

exchange_at_m2p2.note: refit with the spiral spins rescaled to the experimental moment; J^S is the standard Heisenberg coefficient (H = -1/2 sum_ij J S_i.S_j, |S| in hbar)

magnon_path.formula: hbar*omega(q) = S sum_n J_n [z_n - S_n(q)], S = m/2

stiffness_vs_moment.note: D from the three smallest commensurate q along [001] on an 8^3 conventional cell, extrapolated omega/q^2 -> q^2 -> 0; the exponent is a log-log slope over 1.8-2.6 muB

magnetostriction.note: fractional phonon shift per fractional change of |S|, d ln(omega)/d ln(m) with m = 2.45 +- 0.15 muB; this is the magnetostrictive (exchange-striction) channel, NOT the transverse magnon vertex, which vanishes at a collinear state. null entries = modes below 1 THz (log ratio undefined)

crossings.note: exact crossings (not avoided): the transverse magnon-phonon vertex vanishes at a collinear state, so the two sectors do not hybridise; the measured |C| bounds any residual gap. The degenerate Gamma points (both branches at zero, and the 3e-3 THz acoustic residue) are excluded from the count
